# JAOT

> JAOT is an AI-powered optimization platform and model marketplace where businesses,
> developers, and students can formulate, solve, and analyze optimization problems
> without deep mathematical expertise. Build versioned optimization models with AI
> assistance, fork solver-agnostic marketplace models into your own studio, or connect
> AI agents via the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Free and collaborative — no billing,
> no credits; fair use via rate limits and solve quotas.

## Getting Started

- [Introduction](/docs/getting-started/introduction): Platform overview and first steps
- [Quick Start](/docs/getting-started/quick-start): Solve your first optimization problem
- [The Model Workspace](/docs/studio/model-workspace): Build, analyze, version, and solve a model in one place

## API Reference

- [Solve API](/docs/api/solve): Submit and retrieve optimization problems programmatically
- [Models API](/docs/api/models): Browse the marketplace catalog and manage versioned model projects

## MCP Integration

- [MCP Overview](/docs/mcp/overview): Connect AI agents to the solver via MCP (26 tools)
- Tools: solve_problem, validate_problem, solve_multi_objective, list_available_solvers, list_templates, get_template, solve_with_template, import_preview, import_and_solve, export_model, export_execution, list_catalog_models, get_catalog_model, get_catalog_model_schema, execute_model, get_execution, get_execution_insights, create_model_project, create_model_project_from_marketplace, get_model_project, list_model_projects, update_model_project_draft, commit_model_version, list_project_versions, get_model_stats, solve_model_project

## Marketplace

- [Browse Models](/marketplace): Ready-made optimization models across 10 problem categories — fork any of them into your studio with "Use in studio"
- [Publishing Models](/docs/marketplace/publishing-models): Publish a committed version of your model to the marketplace
